CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_BranchGroupDescription_DEP
AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription AS 
(
SELECT
	 BDS.SET_ID AS BranchGroupId
	,BDS.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,BDS.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
	,BDS.SET_DESC AS BranchGroupDescription
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BDS.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
    ,BDSD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_SETIDTABLE_DELTA BDSD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_SETIDTABLE BDS ON BDSD.SET_ID = BDS.SET_ID AND BDSD.BANK_ID = BDS.BANK_ID AND BDS.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
BranchGroupId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,Timestamp
,BranchGroupDescription
)) HASHROW, BranchGroupId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
BranchGroupId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,Timestamp
,BranchGroupDescription
)) HASHROW, BranchGroupId
FROM BNKM.BranchGroupDescription --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'DEP'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.BranchGroupId,TGT.BranchGroupId) AS BranchGroupId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.BranchGroupId = TGT.BranchGroupId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	BranchGroupId = SRC.BranchGroupId
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,Timestamp = SRC.Timestamp
	,BranchGroupDescription = SRC.BranchGroupDescription
	,SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.BranchGroupDescription TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.BranchGroupId = TGT.BranchGroupId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription SRC ON SRC.BranchGroupId = TGT.BranchGroupId ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.BranchGroupDescription
(
	BranchGroupId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,Timestamp
	,BranchGroupDescription
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	BranchGroupId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,Timestamp
	,BranchGroupDescription
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupDescription_DELTA;

END
